_ported_from: END_EV_ACQ_* (Frank v6 surfaces 17 + 18, merged pivot + acquisition)
_port_note:
THE BODY IS INLINE, AND THAT IS THE FIX, NOT A STYLE CHOICE. As a CSV row it carried {investor}, {valuation} and {offer}; the presenter resolves {slot} from the bound scope and {seam:ns.name} from the registry, so the two numeric tokens would have reached the screen as literal text - the defect FRANK_VERIFY_2026-08-21.md:166 recorded. {seam:} cannot live in the CSV (loc_csv_integrity's brace rule), so the body moves inline in both locales, the shape customer/request_complaint.json already uses. THE PROSE IS BYTE-EXACT; only the machine token moved, which is precisely what the v6 landing pass itself did to these two tokens ({degerleme} -> {valuation}). The unread END_EV_ACQ_BODY row is recorded in FRANK_ORPHANS rather than deleted.

'Kendi paramla devam' carries TWO effects. The second one is the memory the document rules must survive: refusing to sell is thrown back at the founder in a later VC meeting (vc_pitch_system._sorgu_narrative). Dropping it silently deletes a beat.

tr.title: END_EV_ACQ_TITLE
tr.body:
Series A turu kapandı, ortada anlaşma yok.

{investor} arıyor.

"Şirketi almak isteyen biri var. {seam:funding.acq_valuation} değerleme ile sana düşen miktar bu: {seam:funding.acq_offer}. Karar senin, ben sadece masaya koyuyorum."

Sonra Frank'ten kısa bir mesaj.

"Hangi kararı verirsen ver arkandayım."

en.title: END_EV_ACQ_TITLE
en.body:
The Series A round is closed and there's no deal in it.

{investor} calls.

"There's someone who wants to buy the company. At a {seam:funding.acq_valuation} valuation, your share comes to {seam:funding.acq_offer}. It's your call. I'm just bringing it to you."

Then a short message from Frank.

"Whichever way you go, I'm behind you."
